mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) during periods with three consecutive months of declining FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in a month, SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a weakening housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST (both down > 1% MoM) fails to produce negative 60-day SPX returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below its 12-month moving average, manufacturing output contraction signals reduced corporate capacity utilization and potential earnings cuts, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of observations.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential sales trend (RSAFS) indicates strong household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth does not correlate with positive 5-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a severe labor market contraction that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE (both in the same month) fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production trend (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth does not correlate with positive 5-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.
